configuration:
seed: 42
output_dir: <local path>
study: breast_unet_MIST_HER2
data:
  task: breast_he_to_ihc
  root: <local path>
  train_manifest: train.csv

  datasets:
  - MIST
  crop_size: 256

  persistent_workers: false

  geometry: native_pixels

  in_channels: 3
  base_channels: 48
loss:

  unpadded: true
  selection_mode: min
  aggregation: tile_mean
